name: crypto random bytes and timing safe equality
source: import { randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'; import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; function main(): void { const value = randomBytes(8); console.log(value.length, timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from('same'), Buffer.from('same')), timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from('same'), Buffer.from('diff'))); }
